meta.title: Vendor searches its event list
gaps: Search the Vendor A supplier-portal event list by event title and verify that only that event is listed
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Search the Vendor A supplier-portal event list by event title and verify that only that event is listed

steps.note: Create the event used by this test.
Give the event a known title for the vendor-list search.
Apply the pricing template required before adding line items.
Add the minimum line item needed for a publishable event.
Invite the QA vendor so the event should appear in its portal.
Publish the event before checking the vendor portal.
Confirm the event was created and published.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session intact.
